title: Adjacent Swap
scramble: R' U L U' R U L'
notes: Two adjacent corners need to be swapped
story:
<!-- Case: PcLL Adjacent -->

## Overview
Adjacent corner swap—first step of 2-look PLL, swaps two adjacent corners.

## Recognition
- Top layer fully oriented (yellow cross and corners).
- Two adjacent corners need to swap positions.
- Look for headlights on one side.

## Technique
1. Position corners to swap on front-right.
2. Common algorithm: `L U' R' U L' U' R`.
3. Short, fast corner swap algorithm.

## Fingertricks
- L U' starts with left hand.
- R' U transitions to right.
- L' U' R completes swap.
- Practice L-R hand coordination.

## Common Mistakes
- Not positioning swap corners correctly.
- Fumbling L-R transitions.
- Breaking rhythm mid-algorithm.

## Practice
- Drill 10 times—essential 2-look PLL.
- First step of corner permutation.
- Master for sub-20 times.

- [PcLL Diagonal](deddal://case/PcLL-Diagonal) – Diagonal corner swap.
- [Aa-Perm](deddal://case/Aa-Perm) – Full PLL adjacent swap.
- [Ab-Perm](deddal://case/Ab-Perm) – Full PLL adjacent swap.

## Pro Tips
- Very common 2-look PLL case (95 popularity).
- Headlights indicate adjacent swap.
- Follow with PeLL for full permutation.

title: Diagonal Swap

notes: Two diagonal corners need to be swapped

<!-- Case: PcLL Diagonal -->

## Overview
Diagonal corner swap—second 2-look PLL case, swaps two diagonal corners.

## Recognition
- Top layer fully oriented (yellow cross and corners).
- Two diagonal corners need to swap positions.
- No headlights visible on any side.

## Technique
1. Position for diagonal swap.
2. Common algorithm: `F' R U' R' U' R U R' F R U R' U' R' F R F'`.
3. Long Y-perm style algorithm.

## Fingertricks
- F' R U' R' U' flows naturally.
- R U R' F continues rhythm.
- R U R' U' continues flow.
- R' F R F' completes swap.

## Common Mistakes
- Getting lost in long sequence.
- Breaking rhythm between sections.
- Not recognizing no-headlights pattern.

## Practice
- Drill 20 times—longer algorithm.
- Break into sections for learning.
- Essential 2-look PLL case.
